source: User-provided Career Point University homepage scrape
purpose: Reference dataset for evaluating retrieval quality using contextual recall and contextual precision.

fields.input: User query sent to the RAG system.
fields.expected_output: Ground-truth answer supported by the supplied homepage scrape.
fields.expected_retrieval_context: Relevant facts/passages that should be present in retrieved context.

test_cases.expected_output: Career Point University (CPU) is a self-financed private university in Kota, Rajasthan, backed by the 33-year legacy of Career Point Group and reporting over 14 years of academic excellence.
expected_retrieval_context: Career Point University is a self-financed private university in Rajasthan.
CPU is located in Kota, Rajasthan.

test_cases.input: Where is Career Point University located?
test_cases.expected_output: Career Point University is located on National Highway 52, opposite Alaniya Mata Ji Mandir, Alaniya, Kota, Rajasthan 325003.
expected_retrieval_context: National Highway 52, Opp Alaniya Mata Ji Mandir, Alaniya, Kota, Rajasthan 325003.

test_cases.input: Is Career Point University UGC approved?
test_cases.expected_output: The homepage lists UGC – University Grants Commission under Recognition and Disclosures and describes CPU as UGC approved.

test_cases.input: What is the academic focus of Career Point University?
test_cases.expected_output: CPU describes itself as an AI-First University and says it integrates industry-relevant AI learning across its programmes.
expected_retrieval_context: Integrates industry-relevant AI learning across all programs.

test_cases.input: How many schools are listed at CPU, and what are their names?
test_cases.expected_output: The homepage lists nine schools: Engineering & Technology; Computer Application & Technology; Commerce & Management; Legal Studies & Governance; Agricultural Sciences; Basic & Applied Sciences; Health & Allied Sciences; Arts & Humanities; and Education.

test_cases.input: What types of academic programmes does CPU offer?
test_cases.expected_output: CPU lists Diploma, Undergraduate, Integrated, Dual Degree, Postgraduate, and Doctoral programmes.

test_cases.input: Which academic session has open admissions announced?
test_cases.expected_output: The homepage announces admissions open for the 2026–27 academic session.

test_cases.input: Where can I find CPU's fee structure?
test_cases.expected_output: The homepage provides a Fee Structure link under Quick Admission Links, but the scraped homepage text does not include fee amounts.
Yes. The homepage lists a Scholarship section for Indian students. Scholarship amounts and eligibility conditions are not provided in the scrape.

test_cases.input: What placement support does CPU advertise?
test_cases.expected_output: CPU advertises placement opportunities, 100% placement assistance, and more than 350 companies visited so far.

test_cases.input: What average placement offer does CPU advertise?
test_cases.expected_output: The homepage advertises an average offer of 4 LPA. It does not specify the batch or calculation method.

test_cases.input: Which research areas are highlighted on the CPU homepage?
test_cases.expected_output: The homepage highlights nano herbal drug delivery in cancer treatment; plant stress adaptation using defense, nanotechnology and genetics; and resveratrol in Alzheimer's therapy.
expected_retrieval_context: Nano Herbal Drug Delivery in Cancer Treatment.
Plant Stress Adaptation: Defense, Nanotech & Genetics.

test_cases.input: What clubs and student activities are advertised at CPU?
test_cases.expected_output: CPU advertises 15+ clubs and societies and 100+ annual events.

test_cases.input: What is the admission helpline number of CPU?
test_cases.expected_output: The admission helpline number listed on the homepage is +91-9079134713.

test_cases.input: Can a PCB student get admission into B.Tech at Career Point University?
test_cases.expected_output: The provided homepage scrape does not state B.Tech eligibility criteria or confirm whether PCB students are eligible. The applicant should consult the specific B.Tech eligibility information or contact the admissions office at +91-9079134713.

evaluation_notes: Use expected_retrieval_context as the reference relevance content; compare it with the actual chunks returned by the retriever.
For contextual recall, check whether the retrieved chunks contain the information needed to support expected_output.
For contextual precision, check whether retrieved chunks are relevant to input and expected_output, and penalize irrelevant chunks.
Do not treat expected_retrieval_context entries as mandatory exact chunk strings; semantically equivalent retrieved passages can be relevant.
The homepage scrape does not provide course-level eligibility, fee amounts, scholarship criteria, hostel pricing, or a NAAC grade. The RAG system should not invent these details.
CPU006 contains nine schools in the source text; the dataset uses nine, not eight.
